correctness.rationale: TARGET route: denominator identity T^1=2d for lines through 0 is elementary, but the hard sufficiency s>=1/(2d) is not proved. Fatal gap at origin: for d>=2, J(0)=0 so ker dim is 5, not <=2, yet the rescaled compact K={|F|<=C} contains 0 and is claimed covered by balls at sphere points p with only a 2-variable lemma. No origin analysis, no Levi-form computation for psi_{p,delta}, no preservation of Hessian lower bound under max-convolution/mollifier, no box-stability covering (the hard part in Catlin-Cho). Lemma statement is vague (datum equals 1, tensor-derivative) and its slicing claim t<=d is shown only for lines through 0, not affine restrictions p+K_p. Uniform sup_p(h_p+2)<=2d is asserted without proof. Example certification is sampling (60000 points + local refinement, reproduced: min|F|~0.18, sigma3~0.036) not a global sphere lower bound, so isolated-zero/rank>=3 for the example and nonvacuity are not rigorously established.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent (sum-of-squares/finite-type/multitype/commutator), and dominance (stronger theorem/census/database) directions plus full-text inspection of the two nearest priors shows no coverage of sharp 1/(2d) for generic homogeneous non-triangular rank-two special domains in C^6. Catlin-Cho and Khanh-Zampieri require triangular regular-coordinate hypotheses which the generic example F_i=z_iL_i violates, and the general finite-type bound is tower-weak, while D'Angelo multiplicity bound gives 1/(2d^5), far weaker than claimed sharp 1/(2d). No database table lists this parameter. Hence the headline, if proved, would be new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: If correct, sharp subellipticity s=1/(2d)=1/tilde-T^1 for a generic/nonempty rank-two homogeneous special-domain class in C^6, extending beyond the rank-one/triangular cases toward D'Angelo's program, is a natural exact invariant of a pre-motivated object (pseudoconvex domains, Bergman-related dbar-Neumann gain, type/commutator numbers). A future researcher could reasonably need the precise gain; it is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
